red.note: AI Red (Stage 5.6, OpenAI). gpt-6-luna is the cheapest current model (D12; id confirmed in the pinned SDK). effort maps to reasoning effort; max_output_tokens 2048 (reasoning tokens count toward it); round_cap is the number of Red slots. caching (Stage 5.7): off | on; on = explicit breakpoints at the end of every user turn, 30-minute TTL (the only priced write); a cost setting, not a brain setting, but held constant within any comparison. These are recorded in match.json red_params; hold them constant within any comparison. The guard caps live in red/red_guard.py.

blue.note: AI Blue (Stage 5.4, Anthropic). Cheapest current-generation model for development (D12). max_output_tokens, request, the structured output format and the rules block are part of the Blue configuration: hold them constant within any comparison (recorded in match.json blue_params). chunk_size > 1 is refused for scored matches (D4). rules (Stage 5.5): mode off = prompt v1, no rules (identical to 5.4); shadow = prompt v2, proposals validated, recorded and scored, never hot-loaded; on = prompt v2, proposals hot-loaded (D9). max_rules caps stored rules per match. max_output_tokens 512 for all three modes (designer, Stage 5.5: 256 could cut off a reply carrying a three-condition rule). caching (Stage 5.7): off | on; on = one explicit breakpoint on the system block, 5-minute TTL (the only priced write); a cost setting, not a brain setting, but held constant within any comparison.

analyst.note: AI analyst (Stage 7 #17, D53): post-hoc only, never in the loop, never a judge. Model chosen by the probe (tools/build_report.py --probe: gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6.1-terra, gpt-5.6-sol, fallback claude-sonnet-5-5); Chosen 2026-11-24 (designer, from the probe evidence): gpt-6.1-sol; report-run fallback order gpt-6.1-terra, then claude-sonnet-5-5 (tools/build_report.py REPORT_ORDER). Analyst runs use cap $1 (caps.analyst; tools/build_report.py also raises the match cap to $1 for the analyst run folder).
